title: Yellow Peppered Norwegian Salmon Risotto
description: A creamy and peppery risotto recipe featuring Norwegian salmon, coriander leaves, and a twist of lemon zest.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add the white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely absorbed.
Add 1 cup of vegetable broth and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Repeat the process, adding the broth in 1-cup increments, until the rice is cooked and creamy.
While the risotto cooks, prepare the salmon by seasoning with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and add the salmon fillets.
Cook the salmon for 4-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Flake the cooked salmon into large pieces and set aside.
Stir in the lemon zest and cook for 1 minute.
Remove the risotto from the heat and stir in the flaked salmon and chopped coriander leaves.
